The three papers do not report comparable numbers: **the DPO paper reports none**, and ORPO and SimPO use different setups.

| Paper | Mistral-7B model / setting | AlpacaEval 2 result for its own method |
|---|---|---|
| **DPO** | — | Not reported |
| **ORPO** | Mistral-ORPO-α | 11.33% (p. 6, Table 1) |
| | Mistral-ORPO-β | 12.20% (p. 6, Table 1) |
| **SimPO** | Mistral-Base | LC 21.5%, raw win rate 20.8% (p. 6, Table 4) |
| | Mistral-Instruct | LC 32.1%, raw win rate 34.8% (p. 6, Table 4) |

**DPO:** The paper uses no Mistral models and no AlpacaEval. Its experiments cover sentiment generation (GPT-2-large), TL;DR summarization (GPT-J) and Anthropic-HH dialogue (Pythia-2.8B), with GPT-4 win rates against reference or chosen responses (pp. 7–9). It notes it tested "models up to 6B parameters" (p. 10).

**ORPO:**
- Mistral-ORPO-α was trained on UltraFeedback with λ = 0.1 (p. 6).
- Mistral-ORPO-β uses the same configuration on a cleaned version of UltraFeedback (p. 6).
- The paper calls this "AlpacaEval2.0," judged by GPT-4-turbo against GPT-4's responses (p. 5). It does not say whether the number is length-controlled.

**SimPO:**
- **Base setting:** Mistral-7B-v0.1 is first fine-tuned on UltraChat-200k, then trained on UltraFeedback (p. 4).
- **Instruct setting:** Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 is trained on regenerated UltraFeedback pairs (p. 4).
- GPT-4 Turbo is both the baseline and the judge (p. 5, Table 2).
- Table 10 lists the Mistral-Base length-controlled score as 21.4% rather than 21.5% (p. 25).

**Why they aren't directly comparable:** the base models, training data and judge setups differ between the papers.

**Related numbers from SimPO's own reruns:** on Mistral-Base, the SimPO paper reports DPO at 15.1% LC / 12.5% raw and ORPO at 14.7% LC / 12.2% raw (p. 6, Table 4). These come from SimPO's experiments, not from the DPO or ORPO papers.
